steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Use avoir mal à plus a body part. The small word changes to match the article: au, à la, à l' or aux.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.tip: Say it: zhay mahl ah lah teht
Say it: zhay mahl oh doh
Say it: zhay mahl ah lah gorzh
Say it: zhay mahl ah loh-RAY
Say it: zhay mahl oh zyuh

steps.fr: J'ai mal au ventre depuis hier.
steps.en: My stomach has hurt since yesterday.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay mahl oh vah(n)tr duh-PWEE yeh-R
Say it: zhuh swee mah-LAHD ay fah-tee-GAY

steps.fr: J'ai un rhume et une toux.
steps.en: I have a cold and a cough.
steps.tip: Say it: zhay uh(n) rüm ay ün too
Say it: zhuh voo-DREH uh(n) rah(n)-day-VOO
Say it: poo-vay-voo ehk-splee-KAY lah noh-TEES
